citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
An APHIS official observed one (1) ring-tailed lemur housed alone. However, the nonhuman primate environment
enhancement plan does not address the special attention required for certain nonhuman primates, such as individually
housed primates unable to see and hear nonhuman primates of their own or compatible species. An incomplete
environment enhancement plan can negatively impact animal welfare if adequate environment enhancement is not
provided due to a lack of detail in the plan. Nonhuman primate environment enhancement plans must address certain
nonhuman primates that must be provided special attention regarding enhancement of their environment, such as
individually housed nonhuman primates and other categories defined in this subsection in accordance with the
instructions of the attending veterinarian. Correct by June 25, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
Additional Inspectors:
Michael Brooks, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
